text: Okay, so I would say the thin line range is limited, but that is on most of these. Some have blue dots, some don't, some have pink dots, some don't. However, number 20 doesn't have dots for either. It has the largest blue expansion in pinks, about average. I would have said like 7, 12, 17, but those all kind of fall in the middle-ish without much going to the left side. I think 20 has the longest expanded ranges for blue, but average in the pink, but neither have dots continuing out from them. So number 20.
